positions.name: FerryLateSailingTimetableAndRidershipDemand
positions.frame: how should late-night ferry sailing schedules be adjusted in response to weekday ridership demand versus weekend capacity utilization?
positions.why: src-1 announces the weekday timetable curtailment from November, src-2 grounds the change in low ridership on late weekday sailings, and src-3 justifies preserving the existing weekend timetable based on full capacity utilization on Friday and Saturday nights.
